comments.body: 2026-11-07 instance (Mac Mini): a worker pane read reviewer message #11 in its group with `muster msg read` about ten minutes before it ended its turn; a wake then arrived saying "1 new (#11), 1 to you", and `muster msg read` printed "nothing unread". Cost one turn.
comments.author: Alexander Terp

creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Seen 2026-11-01 on a Claude Code pane in a parallel-work round. A reviewer's report arrived mid-turn and the agent read it with `msg read --group`. Several turns later, after a turn ended with `report --waiting`, a wake arrived naming that message, and the read said "nothing unread". The wake cost a turn.

a_2cP6w1lHN and a_2pPidIbLL fixed Codex forms of this. Re-check a pending wake against the group's read state just before typing it.
title: A queued wake is delivered for a message read since it was queued
